faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NBCFDC recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the NBCFDC Consultant (HR) & Young Associate (IT) posts is 08 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this NBCFDC recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the posts of Consultant (HR) and Young Associate (IT) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for these NBCFDC posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Consultant (HR) post?
faq.answer: For the Consultant (HR) post, a Graduate in any discipline is required. A Degree/Diploma in HR related field/LLB will be considered an additional qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification for the Young Associate (IT) post?
faq.answer: The educational qualification for the Young Associate (IT) post is B.Tech. (Computer Science/ Computer Science & Engineering/Information Technology) or MCA from a recognized University / Institution.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for applying to NBCFDC posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Consultant (HR) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Consultant (HR) post ranges from Rs.80,000/- to Rs.1,45,000/- per month consolidated for retired CPSE, and as per DoPT guidelines for retired Government employees.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for the Young Associate (IT) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Young Associate (IT) post is a fixed amount of Rs.45,000/- per month, which is negotiable.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for NBCFDC recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' description.

faq.question: Q10. What is the address to send the application form?
faq.answer: The specific address for sending the application form will be detailed in the official notification PDF. Candidates are advised to refer to it for complete details.
